description: Track dollar-cost-averaging crypto buys — total invested, coins held, average cost and profit/loss at the current price.

faqs.a: Average cost = total invested ÷ total coins bought. Each buy adds amount ÷ price coins to your holdings.
Enter the current market price — the tool multiplies your total coins by it for current value and profit/loss.
No — dollar-cost averaging buys on a schedule regardless of price, which this tool tracks. It does not predict or recommend prices.
